service.name: tfactory
service.title: TFactory
service.description: Autonomous test generation and execution. From a branch or PR plus acceptance criteria it runs planner -> gen-functional -> executor (sandboxed) -> evaluator -> triager across five lanes (unit, browser, api, integration, mutation). The evaluator grades every generated test on a 5-signal verdict - coverage delta, stability across re-runs, mutation score, flake lint and semantic relevance - so a pass means meaningful tests, not a green bar.

skills.name: tfactory
skills.description: Onboarding skill: how to work inside the TFactory codebase itself - the 4-agent pipeline, the LLM-provider abstraction (never call a vendor SDK directly), the workspace layout, the branching model, how to run the suite, and the non-negotiable conventions. Install this before changing TFactory, not before using it.

skills.name: handover-to-tfactory
skills.description: Hand a finished feature off to TFactory for polyglot test generation - from AIFactory, from Claude Code, or from any tool via the MCP control plane or a markdown/Gherkin/EARS acceptance-criteria file. Drives the full pipeline across the five lanes and produces a triage report, optionally committing the tests to the feature branch and commenting on the PR.

skills.name: tfactory-watch
skills.description: Poll a running TFactory task to completion, then pick up its triage report and check the generated tests actually cover the acceptance criteria. One check per invocation - drive it under /loop for a hands-off round trip.

skills.name: tfactory-fixloop
skills.description: Close the AIFactory <-> TFactory loop hands-off: hand the correction back to AIFactory, wait for its QA fixer, re-test in TFactory. One bounded cycle per invocation; it stops when the run passes, when the same tests keep failing (no progress), or when the correction-cycle cap is hit and a human is needed.

skills.name: spec-create
skills.description: Create a test spec for a branch or PR from its acceptance criteria, optionally restricted to specific lanes. Returns a spec id and the RFC-0001 correlation key.

skills.name: spec-run
skills.description: Execute the generated suite for a spec in the sandbox, optionally for a subset of the five lanes.

skills.name: spec-report
skills.description: Fetch the triage report and the 5-signal verdict for a spec: coverage delta, stability, mutation score, lint and semantic relevance, with the ranked findings a human or an agent should act on.

skills.name: handback
skills.description: Route a correction back to AIFactory's QA fixer when the verdict fails: the failing tests plus the report, keyed by correlation key so the fix lands on the original build.
